translations.audience.title: Who we serve
translations.audience.lead: We help businesses worldwide source high-quality IQF berries from Ukraine — consistently, transparently and hassle-free.
translations.audience.statText: We work with a wide range of market players — from international traders to finished-goods manufacturers and HoReCa venues.
translations.audience.cardText1: We ensure stable deliveries and full supply chain transparency.
translations.audience.cardText2: Reliable raw materials for juices, smoothies and other beverages.
translations.audience.cardText3: IQF berries for confectionery, bakery and other food applications.
translations.audience.cardText4: We help you find verified suppliers for your own brands.
translations.audience.cardText5: We supply quality IQF berries to restaurants, hotels and catering companies.
translations.audit.brief.title: Audit brief
translations.audit.brief.requirementsValue: Take 3 samples from the raspberry batch, check the temperature logs for the last month, video of the cold room.
translations.audit.step1.title: Choose a producer
translations.audit.step1.text: From the platform catalog, or name your own supplier you want to check.
translations.audit.step2.title: Write the audit brief
translations.audit.step2.text: Describe what the auditor must do: which areas, documents, processes and batches to check, and by when.
translations.audit.step3.title: The auditor visits the site
translations.audit.step3.text: An independent auditor inspects the site strictly according to your brief, with photo and video evidence.
translations.audit.step4.title: Get the report in your account
translations.audit.step4.text: A report with findings for every item of the brief appears in your account on the platform.
translations.audit.report.point1: A finding for every item of your brief: compliant, remark or non-compliant
translations.audit.report.point2: Photos and videos from the site, linked to specific items
translations.audit.report.point3: Copies of documents and laboratory test results
translations.audit.report.point4: The auditor's overall conclusion and recommendations
translations.audit.report.point5: All reports stay in your account — download them as PDF and share with your team

translations.audit.title: Check a producer against your own brief
translations.audit.lead: Order an independent audit of an IQF berry producer: describe exactly what the auditor should check — and get a detailed report in your account on the platform.
translations.audit.how.title: From brief to report — four steps
translations.audit.include.title: You decide exactly what the auditor checks
translations.audit.include.lead: Pick ready-made items or describe your own requirements — the auditor works strictly to your brief.
translations.audit.include.capacity.text: Actual production capacity, freezing volumes and stock available in the warehouse.
translations.audit.include.cold.text: Blast freezing, storage temperature, temperature logs and the condition of cold rooms.
translations.audit.include.docs.text: Presence and validity of certificates, permits, declarations and internal quality procedures.
translations.audit.include.trace.text: Labelling, records and the link between a specific batch and its field, harvest and freezing dates.
translations.audit.include.lab.text: Samples taken from your batch and sent to a laboratory for the parameters you specify.
translations.audit.include.media.title: Photo and video report
translations.audit.include.media.text: Footage of production halls, the warehouse, packing and the specific batch — with date.
translations.audit.report.title: The result — in your account on the platform
translations.audit.final.title: Want to check a producer before you buy?
translations.audit.final.text: Write a brief — we'll find an auditor and let you know the timing and cost.

translations.process.title: From request to {$START_TAG_SPAN}your delivery{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.process.lead: We take care of finding and vetting producers, assembling the batch and organizing logistics. You choose the products you need, and we guide the process until you receive the goods.
translations.process.noteText: Transparent, with a full document package and quality control.
translations.process.cardPara1: Choose IQF berries in the catalog, create a request and specify your product requirements and certificates.
translations.process.cardPara2: We clarify the details and prepare a commercial offer tailored to your needs.
translations.process.cardPara3: We select reliable suppliers and check product quality, certification and required documents.
translations.process.cardPara4: If needed, we arrange an independent production audit and laboratory testing.
translations.process.cardPara5: We agree on volumes, packaging and lead times.
translations.process.cardPara6: If needed, we consolidate products from several producers into one truck, optimizing loading and transport costs.
translations.process.cardPara7: We coordinate loading, refrigerated transport and export documentation.
translations.process.cardPara8: You track the delivery status and access all documents in one place.
translations.process.cardPara9: IQF berries arrive at your warehouse on the agreed schedule.
translations.process.cardPara10: You receive a full set of shipping documents and a transparent history of every batch — from producer to delivery.
translations.siteFooter.tagline: A B2B platform for buying Ukrainian IQF berries with traceability for every batch.
translations.testimonials.title: What our partners say
translations.testimonials.lead: In the words of people who regularly buy berries through BerryTrace.
translations.testimonials.quote1: I regularly order frozen berries and grits here. What I like most is that everything is fast and high quality, with no surprises. I write, get a reply, we agree — and off we go.
translations.testimonials.quote2: We have worked with the BerryTrace team from day one and are still happy. This is exactly the case where the partnership rests not only on a contract, but on genuine human trust.
translations.testimonials.quote3: We've bought more than one truckload from them. Things happen — sometimes customs delays, sometimes delays with lab analyses. But there hasn't been a single situation we couldn't solve together.
translations.trust.title: You know{$LINE_BREAK}who you buy from,{$LINE_BREAK}what you get{$LINE_BREAK}{$START_TAG_SPAN}and where your batch is{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
translations.trust.lead: We minimize the risks of international IQF berry procurement. We vet producers, control quality and ensure transparency at every stage of delivery.
translations.trust.cardText1: We work with Ukrainian producers and check documents, production capacity and compliance with your requirements. If needed, we arrange an independent audit.
translations.trust.cardText2: Review of specifications, certificates and lab results. If needed — additional batch testing before shipment.
translations.trust.cardText3: From product origin to delivery status — key information and shipping documents in one place. You always know where your berries come from and what stage they are at.
translations.trust.cardText4: We coordinate batch assembly, refrigerated transport, export documents and delivery. One contact for all delivery questions — from the plant to your warehouse.
translations.trustedBy.title: Companies that already {$START_TAG_SPAN}choose BerryTrace{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}
